svg.text: LED driver: six 74HC595 shift registers in a chain (all 48 LEDs from 3 Arduino pins)
the LED modules and the sensors
D13 clock: pin 11 of every chip
D10 latch: pin 12 of every chip
pin 9 of each chip -> pin 14 of the next
On every chip: pins 16 (VCC) and 10 (MR) to 5V, pins 8 (GND) and 13 (OE) to GND, and a 100 nF capacitor from pin 16 to pin 8, as close to the chip as you can.
Every head is wired the same way: its red, amber and green pins to three outputs
in a row, its GND pin to GND. Head Hn uses LEDs 3n, 3n+1, 3n+2; LED m is
output Q(m mod 8) of chip #(m div 8 + 1) - the table in HARDWARE.md, section 5.
Modules without built-in resistors need 220-330 ohm in series with each LED.
